name: Paris
hook: Café mornings, the Seine at dusk
description: The city that invented the long lunch — bakeries queued before nine, an afternoon lost inside the Louvre rather than rushed through it, and a Seine-side walk home as the Eiffel Tower starts to sparkle.

quickFacts.flightNote: ~7–8hr direct from the US East Coast
quickFacts.climate: Temperate — mild summers, cool and grey winters

topExperiences: The Louvre, given a proper half-day rather than a rush
Sunset from the steps of Sacré-Cœur
A slow river cruise past Notre-Dame
